anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: This month is the beginning of months — now with σοί, 'for you'.
Perfect love; possible frame for τελείας ἀγάπης.

pass_a_gloss: One must come to be inside a perfect way of life and perfect love, so that someone still being in the present world may be able to hear: This month is beginning of months for you.
pass_b_english: A person must come inside a perfect way of life and perfect love, so that someone still in the present world may be able to hear: This month is the beginning of months for you (Exodus 12:2) (1 John 4:18).
source_text: Τελείας δὲ πολιτείας καὶ τελείας ἀγάπης ἐντὸς γε||νέσθαι δεῖ, ἵνα τις ἔτι ἐν κόσμῳ τῷ ἐνεστῶτι ὢν ἀκοῦσαι δυνηθῇ· Ὁ μὴν οὗτος ἀρχὴ μ[η]νῶν ἐστιν σοί.
